messages:
Tara (growth): Quick idea — add an inline 'estimate your bill' widget to the pricing page + simplify tier names to Short / Committed / Enterprise. Could reduce confusion and drop support tickets. Quick sync?

Emilio: love this. Do we have capacity to build interactive calc? Might be able to reuse the docs-site calculator component.

Kiran: Copy q: 'Committed' vs 'Reserved' — legal usually dislikes 'reserved'. I think 'Committed' is fine but we need a tiny FAQ about overages.

Jess: Also — routing note: if someone's estimate is >= $10k/mo, route to AE queue. Mid-range (1k-10k) get webinar invite + SDR nurture, low estimates go through self-serve funnel. I can change inbound rules.

marketing-bot: A/B test scheduled: start 2025-03-24. Variant A = widget + simplified labels, Variant B = control.

Tara (growth): Metrics to track: estimator engagement %, CTA click-to-start, MQL conversion, and support ticket mentions about pricing. Target: +15% signups from pricing page.

Emilio: Implementation note — we'll embed via iframe or lightweight script. Example embed (prototype):
```html
<script src="/widgets/pricing-estimator.js" data-tier-preselect="free"></script>
<iframe id="estimator-embed" src="/widgets/estimator?embed=true" style="width:100%;height:420px;border:0"></iframe>
```
Need to confirm CSP headers and cookie/GDPR consent before launch.

Kiran: FAQ microcopy suggestion:
Q: How are committed units applied?
A: Committed units are deducted monthly. Usage above the commitment is billed at the overage rate. Short and link to T&Cs.

Sol (sales): For routing: if estimator output >= 10k -> tag lead "pricing-high" and auto-assign to AE queue. If 1k-10k -> tag "webinar-nurture" and trigger webinar CTA + cadence.

Jess: Also want a short benchmark blurb to test on the page: "Redwood Inference typically reduces inference cost per token by 20–40% vs default serving" — we should A/B test percent vs dollar framing.

Tara (growth): Next steps:
 - Emilio: prototype embed by 2025-03-10
 - Jess: update routing rules + webinar CTA by 2025-03-12
 - Kiran: draft FAQ microcopy + legal check by 2025-03-11
 - Sol: create AE tagging workflow by 2025-03-13
I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow. :calendar:

Emilio: noted — will ping when prototype is up. Might need frontend help for iframe styling.

Kiran: looping in legal and CS for sign-off, will post comments in thread. +1 on keeping FAQ concise.

marketing-bot: Reminder: if estimator increases API calls, tag #eng-runtime for perf review. :robot_face:
